framework: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

rules.title: FSSAI Logo and 14-digit License Number
rules.description: The FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number must be displayed prominently on the food package.

rules.title: List of Ingredients
rules.description: List of ingredients in descending order of ingoing weight/volume with INS numbers for additives.

rules.title: Vegetarian / Non-Vegetarian Declaration
rules.description: Green filled circle in green outline square for Veg, or brown triangle in brown outline square for Non-Veg.

rules.title: Nutritional Information per 100g / serve
rules.description: Mandatory declaration of Energy, Protein, Carbohydrates, Total Sugars, Added Sugars, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, and Sodium.
